description: Create ONE public share link for a ZIP of several documents. The ZIP is built in the background: the bundle starts as status 'pending' and becomes usable once get_share_link_bundle reports 'ready'. The `slug` identifies the public link.

expiration_days.description: Days until the link expires; omit or null for no expiry

file_version.description: Which file of each document to include (default archive)

name: create_share_link_bundle
